title: BUGFIX — Stage 3 (Clip Detection) false-FAIL in validate-orchestrator.ts when RapidAPI unavailable
rationale: validate-orchestrator.ts line 43 has hard assert for '3-clip-detection' stage. When RapidAPI is unavailable, the orchestrator synthesises clips from discovery metadata and SKIPS the clip-detection stage entirely. This causes the Block F test to FAIL even when all pipeline output is correct (22 videos edited/captioned/QC-passed, 198 published). Real pipeline run stages: ['1-trend','2-discovery','2.5-viral-tiktok','4-insight','5-script',...] — no '3-clip-detection'. Fix: replace hard assert with conditional info log when stage absent.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/validate-orchestrator.ts line 43: replace `assert(stageNames.includes('3-clip-detection'), 'Stage 3 (Clip Detection) executed');` with: `if (stageNames.includes('3-clip-detection')) { assert(true, 'Stage 3 (Clip Detection) executed (RapidAPI path)'); } else { console.log('  ℹ Stage 3 (Clip Detection) skipped — synthesised clips path (RapidAPI unavailable)'); }`. Add a comment: '// Stage 3 is optional: RapidAPI path runs clip-detection; fallback path synthesises from discovery metadata'. Do NOT change any other assertions.
